canDo: Can relate 5–7 completed events in order, in the past.
review: Review the present; learn avoir + participe passé and common past participles.
input: Listening: looking back on a weekend/event; reading: a short diary.
output: Write 80–90 words about “last weekend”; retell it aloud in time order in 90 seconds.
checkpoint: At least 5 sentences of past events; don’t leave verbs in the present.
challenge: Today’s challenge: pick 3 photos from last weekend on your phone, say what you did in each with 2 sentences in the passé composé (with avoir), then tell it aloud in the order d’abord → ensuite → enfin, in under 90 seconds.

questions.why: The opening « Je n'ai pas répondu plus tôt » gives the purpose of the letter; the book has been kept safe, not lost.
The text gives a single reason: problème de portière; starting at eight is not late.
Compare « J'ai déjà rangé la cuisine » with « je n'ai pas encore ouvert la moitié des cartons ».
4 000 versus 3 200 is the only year-on-year figure; the number of exposants isn’t compared with anything.
septembre is the date of the next edition, not how the money is used.
The text says l'après-midi a été très animé, and the total number went up.
Four stars, prix correct, the next one already booked — all point to a positive review; the only negative is the wait.
lentement is praised as a strength, not the cause of a delay.
réservé l'atelier « sauces » is a booking for herself; the text doesn’t mention giving it as a gift again.
22 minus « trois de plus » gives 19; 22 is this season’s figure and 41 is the number of new members.
The lack of volunteers is a Sunday-morning problem, unrelated to these two cancellations; the trailer has been repaired.
The only decision in the text is une formation courte en octobre.
The message does two things: tells a story + passes on Inès’s message.
« préviens-la vite » is a clear instruction; rappels here means encores, not calling back.
He says clearly « je les ai toutes ratées ».
He explicitly rejects the third option: « plutôt que baisser la qualité ».
The customers are a consequence, not a cause, and he only learnt how they reacted afterwards.
« mieux que je ne l'avais imaginé » states it clearly.
The compte rendu has been reread and salle 2 is booked.
« seulement la première partie » is the fallback plan proposed.
« La dernière fois, on a oublié » points straight to the coffee.
The last sentence states the main point clearly; sending out thirty applications is exactly what didn’t work.
boulangère → sa cousine: the chain is clear.
une trentaine is the number of applications sent; six is the number of weeks.
